neighbours.label: a word remarked on as odd or under discussion as a term ('this unusual tree', '"free" refers to', 'contrary to its name')
fire: Despite its odd name, the sea cucumber is an animal.
This peculiar fish can walk on the sea floor.
In the phrase "open source", "open" refers to access, not price.
Contrary to its name, the firefly is a beetle.
This unusual shrub flowers in the middle of winter.
What on earth is wrong with that cat?
The term "extreme" is relative and depends on context.
Oddly enough, the titmouse is a bird, not a rodent.
quiet: The sea cucumber lives on the ocean floor.
This fish swims in shallow coastal waters.
Open source projects accept contributions from anyone.
The firefly glows on warm summer nights.
This shrub grows well in sunny gardens.
The cat slept on the porch all afternoon.
Extreme heat closed several schools this week.
The titmouse visited our feeder every morning.
